title: What's New in Sustainability: Measure All Gasses as Carbon Equivalents (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Business value and emission factor challenges
Enabling carbon equivalents and UI changes
Live demonstration of before and after

features.name: Measure all gases as carbon equivalents
features.description: Feature allows users to configure the system to measure all greenhouse gas emissions as carbon dioxide equivalents rather than entering individual emission factors for each gas type. Simplifies data entry and enables standardized emissions reporting.
caveats: Requires enabling the setting in sustainability setup
Organization must choose between two models: detailed per-gas tracking or carbon equivalent approach
Pre-configured emission factors assume a value of 1 for carbon equivalent factors by default

features.name: Automatic emission factor pre-setup
features.description: When carbon equivalents feature is enabled, the system automatically pre-configures emission factors with carbon equivalent values set to 1.0 as the default base value.
caveats: Default value of 1 may need customization based on specific carbon equivalent factors required

features.name: Dynamic caption changes based on setup
features.description: UI captions throughout the system automatically update based on whether carbon equivalents mode is enabled. Captions change from specific gas names (e.g. 'Default Metan') to 'Default Carbon Equivalent for CH4'.
caveats: Caption changes appear across all sustainability-related pages including item cards, purchase documents, and ledger entries

features.name: Use all emissions as carbon equivalent setup option
features.description: New toggle field in Sustainability Setup page that enables the carbon equivalents functionality. When activated, it switches the system to use carbon equivalent values for all gas measurements.
